summary: Iter-11: Care Reminder automation, phone verification, blast test-send and blast results. Backend: 13 new pytest tests (care items CRUD + clinic scoping, seeded items + signup seeding, settings defaults/validation/owner-only, upcoming/run/dedupe/complete, blocked vs failed(Twilio 401), body format, cron auth/dedupe, cron background gating on send_hour/quiet day/last_run_date, /me/mobile start/verify/rate-limit/lockout/replay/delete, campaign test-send rules + 5 limit, results attribution with 7d reply/30d booking windows) -> all pass after fixing an ENV bug. Regression iter10+iter8: 46/47 pass (only test_ip_limit_and_xff_spoof failed — known flaky because preview egress uses 2 IPs). Frontend: Reminders page (rules, chips, send hour, template validation toast, Run now toast, Next 30 days w/ No care consent badges, Send log), Patient Care due tab (add/done/delete), Settings My mobile number (invalid phone + Twilio 401 toasts, Verified badge), Marketing (Send test to my phone -> 'Verify mobile first' and 'Test send failed: HTTP 401' toasts, Results sheet stats and rows correct), non-owner read-only rules / no Run now / no test button — all working.

critical.endpoint: ALL Twilio-using endpoints (/api/reminders/run, /api/me/mobile/start, campaign /test, blast dispatch)
critical.issue: ENV BUG (fixed by me): /app/backend/.env contained 4 VETAURA_ENCRYPTION_KEY lines. python-dotenv takes the LAST one, but stored twilio_credentials were encrypted with the FIRST -> decrypt failed (InvalidToken) -> get_twilio_creds returned None -> sends logged 'Twilio Messaging Service is not connected.' instead of reaching Twilio. Root cause: crypto_service._load_or_create_key() appends a NEW key to .env whenever crypto_service is imported without the env loaded (e.g. `python -c 'import care_reminders'` / lint scripts from /app/backend). Each such import silently rotates the key on next backend restart, bricking every clinic's stored secrets.

minor.issue: Rate limit counts only phone_verifications docs; failed Twilio sends delete their doc, so failed starts are never counted (unlimited Twilio API calls when send fails). Count attempts separately.

A 'blocked' (no consent) or 'failed' (transient Twilio error) send permanently consumes the (item, stage) slot via the unique index — owner who opts in tomorrow, or a Twilio outage, means that stage is never retried. Consider allowing retry for failed / for blocked-then-consented.
Manual run sets last_run_date=today, so the scheduled run that day is skipped; items added between a morning manual run and send_hour wait until tomorrow.

Reply detection uses find_one on receptionist_sessions (only first session per number checked) and lexicographic ISO string comparison (mixed 'Z' vs '+00:00' formats could misorder). N+1 queries per recipient (4 queries each) — slow for big blasts.
If process crashes between insert (status 'processing') and update, record stays 'processing' forever and the stage is never sent.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid campaign-results-{id} on both the Results button and the results summary text (fixed: summary renamed to campaign-results-summary-{id}).
Race: GET /me/mobile resolving after the user starts typing resets the input to '' (setPhone(r.data.phone || '')). Reproduced in Playwright when filling immediately after page load.

After a FAILED test send the list isn't refreshed (onChange only called on success), so the 'N tests sent · last failed' line only appears after reload. Wording '1 test sent' is misleading when it failed.

issues: Uses native <input type='date'> instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker
Shows 'No care items yet.' flash before items load (no loading state)

action_items: CRITICAL: make crypto_service never auto-append keys to .env (fail fast if VETAURA_ENCRYPTION_KEY missing, or call load_dotenv inside crypto_service before reading). Never run module imports from /app/backend without env loaded. Verify .env has exactly ONE VETAURA_ENCRYPTION_KEY (I kept the first, which decrypts existing creds, and restarted backend).
Count failed /me/mobile/start attempts toward the 5/hour limit
Decide retry policy for blocked/failed reminder stages (currently permanent)
MyMobileCard: don't overwrite user-typed phone on late load; refresh campaign list after failed test send
Optional: shadcn date picker in CareItemsPanel; loading state; pluralisation in results sheet
critical_code_review_comments: crypto_service._load_or_create_key appending to .env at import time is a footgun that already corrupted this environment (4 keys).
results(): 4 DB queries per recipient — batch with $in queries for large campaigns.
send_test pushes failed attempts and counts them toward the 5-test cap — OK, but UI should reflect remaining tests.
Frontend DueBadge computes days in browser timezone while backend uses clinic timezone — can be off by one near midnight.

success_rate.backend: 100% of iter11 tests (13/13) after env fix; regression 46/47 (1 known-flaky IP limit)

rca of the issue: Symptom: care reminder with consent logged failed 'Twilio Messaging Service is not connected.' instead of Twilio 401. Repro: decrypt(twilio_credentials.api_key_secret_encrypted) -> InvalidToken; .env had 4 VETAURA_ENCRYPTION_KEY entries, only the first decrypts. Cause: crypto_service writes a fresh key to .env when imported with no env var; dotenv uses last value after restart. Mitigation applied: kept first key, removed duplicates, restarted backend; all Twilio paths now reach Twilio (401 as expected).
